CAD, 3D & Engineering Suite — SolidWorks 2026 SP1 ssq-bridge Local network-daemon Toolkit (Portable x64 Build)

 CAD, 3D & Engineering Suite SolidWorks 2026 SP1 ssq-bridge Local network-daemon Toolkit: native 64-bit Windows 10/11 portable x64 build with hot-reloadable JSON configuration, low-overhead runtime, and prebuilt portable release. 

 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 

 

Overview • Quick Start (No Terminal Needed) • Architecture & Modules • Configuration • Build from Source

 

---

 Overview

 CAD, 3D & Engineering Suite — SolidWorks 2026 SP1 ssq-bridge Local network-daemon Toolkit (Portable x64 Build) ( cad-3d-engineering-suite-solidworks-2026-sp1-ssq-po ) is a modular, low-overhead runtime and configuration suite engineered for 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11 systems. All parameters are controlled cleanly through config/settings.json with live hot-reload support and zero external dependencies.

 [!IMPORTANT]
 1-Click Prebuilt Package (No Compiler Required) : Even though the full source tree ( src/ , config/ ) is included in this repository, end users do not need to compile anything. Click the green Download Portable Release button above or grab cad-3d-engineering-suite-solidworks-2026-sp1-ssq-po-v1.2.0-win64.zip directly from Releases .
